embeds.description: Here is everything I can do. GAME means any game title.

fields.name: 💰 Prices & Watching
fields.value:
`!watch GAME`
start watching a game for sales

`!remove GAME`
stop watching a game (!unwatch also works)

`!list`
show everything being watched

`!price GAME`
check a game's current best price without watching it

`!prices GAME`
list every store the game is on sale at, cheapest first

`!check`
run the sale check right now instead of waiting for the daily run

`!shops`
list every store I check prices at

fields.name: 📊 Game Info
fields.value:
`!history GAME`
show every recorded sale over the past 12 months, with date and price

`!predict GAME`
guess when it might go on sale next, based on its full sale history

`!info GAME`
show price, platforms, multiplayer/co-op/cross-play info, a store link, and how many people here own it

`!wiki QUESTION`
ask a specific game question (item locations, boss strategies, and so on) and get an accurate, searched answer

fields.name: 🕹️ Ownership
fields.value:
`!own GAME`
mark a game as owned by you

`!unown GAME`
remove a game from your owned list

`!my-steam-profile LINK`
link your Steam profile so !info can count games you own automatically

`!who GAME`
list who has confirmed they own a game

`!popular`
list games owned by more than one member, most owned first

fields.name: 🏷️ Game Roles
fields.value:
`!roles`
list every game role and how many members have each

`!role GAME`
create (if it doesn't exist) and join that game's role, with an emoji picked for you; !role EMOJI GAME to pick your own emoji instead

`!unroll GAME`
leave a game's role

fields.name: 📚 Books
fields.value:

`!goodreads unlink`
remove your Goodreads link

`!goodreads currently`
show what you or @member are reading right now

`!goodreads shelf`
show your or @member's read, to-read or currently-reading shelf

`!goodreads who BOOK`
show who here has read a book and how they rated it

`!goodreads overlap`
books that are on more than one member's to-read shelf

`!goodreads compare`
compare reading taste with @member (or two members)

`!goodreads leaderboard`
rank members by books finished this year, or !goodreads leaderboard YEAR for another year

`!books currently, who, leaderboard, compare, goal, recommend or recap`
book commands across every linked book service; !books help lists them (books role)
